description: Ling 3.1 Flash 1019 is InclusionAI's updated hybrid reasoning language model for coding, multi-step analysis, and tool-using agents. Its mixture-of-experts architecture has 560B total parameters with 25B active per token, and its 1M-token context window supports long-document analysis and extended agentic workflows.
name: inclusionAI: Ling 3.1 Flash 1019
